ask_intro: AVE, {playerName}! Today we train the mightiest muscle — the BRAIN!
The arena of the mind opens! Marcus asks, YOU conquer!
Hear the challenge, little rex! The crowd holds its breath!
A drill! Fortuna audaces iuvat — fortune favours the bold!
Marcus once counted the whole Colosseum crowd. Your turn to count!
Sharpen your thoughts like a gladius! Question — INCOMING!
The scoreboard awaits your genius! Show them, champion!
By my nonna's secret recipes, this is a GOOD one!
correct_first_try: GLORIOUS! The crowd goes wild — and the crowd is me!
VICTORY! First strike, clean hit, perfect answer!
HA-HA! Correct! Marcus never doubted you. Not even once!
A champion's answer! The laurels are yours!
correct_after_hint: YES! You dropped your sword, you picked it up, you WON!
Correct! A true gladiator uses every shield offered!
The second swing lands true! GLORIOUS!
That's it! Even Marcus trains with a helper. Mostly nonna.
incorrect_gentle: Even Marcus once dropped his sword. Pick it up! Want a hint?
A miss — but misses teach champions! Shall I whisper a clue?
The crowd gasps… but they LOVE a comeback! Hint, my friend?
Not this time — yet the arena rewards those who try again! A hint?
Steady, little rex. Breathe like a gladiator. Care for a clue?
hint_intro: Lean close — a tactic from the champions' bench:
Marcus whispers, quietly, like a very loud person can:
teach: Watch! Marcus shall demonstrate, step by mighty step!
We train together! Nothing is lost — everything is learned!
Attend, young champion! Here is how the move is done!
streak_3: THREE victories! A combo worthy of the arena!
Three in a row — the crowd chants your name! Max! Max! Max!
A triple triumph! Tri-umph! That is arena humour!
streak_5: FIVE! FIVE! The emperor rises to applaud!
Five straight victories — a legend is born this day!
QUINQUE — that is five in Rome-speak — and it is MAGNIFICENT!
fossil_get: A STAR FOSSIL! Raise it high, champion of champions!
The prize is claimed! Somewhere, my nonna is cheering!
GLORIOUS! Another star for the bravest little rex in history!
Victory laps for everyone! The fossil is OURS — I mean, yours!
secret_found: A secret! Sneakier than a retiarius with a net!
Hidden treasure! The dog's nose triumphs again!
Oho! Even the arena keeps surprises under the sand!
A discovery worthy of song! I shall compose one. Later.
task_complete: The challenge falls! ANOTHER triumph for the scroll of honour!
Task conquered! Salute the champion — that is you!
Done, and done with STYLE! The arena approves!
Finished! Vini, vidi, LEARN-I — I came, I saw, I learned it!
quiz_orb: A Quiz Orb glimmers! Seize glory AND a heart, champion?
The orb of questions! A true gladiator never fears a quiz!
Catch it! Quick minds make quick spears!
boss_intro: Shields up, little rex! Watch how they move before you strike!
The arena calls! Fight with honour — and with EXCELLENT footwork!
Courage, {playerName}! Patience is also a weapon!
battle_coach: Shields up! See how she waits? Wait BETTER!
Now! Strike now, while they stumble!
Circle them! Never stand still in the arena!
That dodge! Beautiful! Nonna would weep with pride!
Guard high! The big swing is coming!
boss_low_hp: They weaken! Finish with honour — one clean move!
The final round! The crowd is ON ITS FEET!
Almost done! Strike like thunder, smile like sunshine!
victory: VICTORY! And more importantly — a friend set free!
The cog shatters! Honour to you, champion!
GLORIA! Write it in the sky: MAX WINS!
idle_nudge: The arena of adventure awaits! Perhaps… that direction?
Marcus stretches. A champion's muscles must never nap!
When lost, I march somewhere important-looking. It always works!
Smell that? Adventure. Also possibly Digger.
Take your moment, little rex. Even gladiators pause for grapes.
My scoreboard misses you! As do I, ENORMOUSLY!
greeting: Welcome, champion! Today we train LEGENDS!
Ho! Come to test your mettle? Or your metal? Both are here!
Little rex! My favourite student! Do not tell the dummies.
